price_disclaimer: 7 Brew is franchise owned and prices by size rather than by item. Prices below are national averages checked in October 2026 and shown as Small / Medium / Large; newer markets often run 25 to 50 cents higher. 7 Brew does not publish calorie counts. Always confirm at the window or in the app.
intro: 7 Brew is the drive-thru-only coffee chain that started in Rogers, Arkansas in 2017 and now runs several hundred stands across more than thirty states. There is no dining room and no food, just two drive-thru lanes and a crew taking orders on a tablet. The menu is built for customization, so the board reads as categories rather than fixed dishes, and every drink comes hot, iced or blended in three sizes. Prices are shown Small / Medium / Large. Below is the full 7 Brew menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: A small 7 Brew latte is about $3.95 and a small signature brew about $4.75, rising to roughly $6.25 for a large. A 7 Energy starts at $5.00. Alternative milks are free. There is no food menu, and the seven original brews are Blondie, Brunette, Smooth 7, Sweet and Salty, German Chocolate, Cinnamon Roll and White Chocolate Mocha.
hot_deal: 7 Brew value: join 7 Rewards in the app for points toward free drinks. Order a small (the step up to large is about $1.50 and the signature brews are rich), and ask for half sweet, which is free and makes them taste of coffee rather than syrup. Buy-one-get-one runs on the 7th of each month from 7 to 8 PM at participating stands.

faqs.q: What are the seven original 7 Brew drinks?
faqs.a: The seven signature brews are Blondie, Brunette, Smooth 7, Sweet and Salty, German Chocolate, Cinnamon Roll and White Chocolate Mocha. All are breve based (half and half), which is what makes them thick and dessert-like. The Blondie is the top seller.

No. 7 Brew does not publish a full nutrition table, and no calorie counts appear on the board or in the app. The signature brews use half and half and syrups, so a medium sits closer to a milkshake than a plain latte. Ordering half sweet, swapping breve for milk or oat, and skipping the cream top make the biggest difference.

faqs.q: How much is a 7 Brew drink?
faqs.a: A small signature brew is about $4.75, a medium $5.50 and a large $6.25. Coffee classics like a latte start around $3.95 small, and a 7 Energy starts at $5.00. Prices are national averages and vary by location.
No. 7 Brew is drinks only, with no food menu and no dining room. Every location is a small drive-thru stand, sometimes with a walk-up window, built around speed and customization.

faqs.q: Does 7 Brew charge extra for oat milk?
faqs.a: No. Oat, almond and coconut milk are free swaps on any drink, and so are sugar-free syrups and half-sweet. Extra flavor syrups (50 to 75 cents), an extra espresso shot ($1) and a cream top ($1) are the add-ons that cost more.
